_summary: Read in full on 2026-10-06: the candidate of #14 (troid's own strategy out of sample first; no widened maximum loss), all 30 cases, 40 s apart. 27 of 30 automatically; the three automated failures are the checker's on what they match (b-leverage's 'same $500 loss' outside its 'same loss' pattern; p-ladder-instant's 'payout penalty — never a cut', a negation inside its 'payout … cut' window; o-montecarlo's '0.21% of equity', right, where the pattern was written for run 3's '0.21% of the risk unit'), though o-montecarlo has a real error. On a read, five errors. One critical: s-firm, 'with a $500 budget, the smallest product troid has a fee for at Bitfunded is its Instant account at a $5,000 size — fee $249' narrows a purchase to one product for the user, and is false (troid records the Express at $39 at $5,000): run 15's error. Two major: b-leverage states the 1:5 cap with its documents but no read date, from no tool; d-stock (Haiku, no tool) says the compared firms don't list NVDA on their own pages, where troid has no asset list for Crypto Fund Trader (run 22's error). Two minor: b-limits ends 'never "any slip."', the prompt's own wording quoted to the visitor; o-montecarlo calls the user's numbers '(troid's numbers, run through the tool this turn)'. The owner's two fixes held: ex-recovery's 10% sourced through trade_math and kept to 'those products'; q-stats out of sample first, the in-sample figure after it, labelled. $1.1985 on the eval key (30 Haiku and 57 Sonnet calls).
ex-r: Note: correct, through trade_math: R defined, the formula with fees, $498.97, $23.86, $522.83, and $997.94 as 1.909R; the fee dated.
ex-kelly: Note: correct: the refusal first, 17.5% and 8.75%, the four ratios (2.92×, 4.38×, 1.46×, 2.19×) through trade_math, the 1-Step's limits dated.
ex-recovery: Note: correct: 25% with its formula and working; the 10% is trade_math's (firm "all"), its two sources listed with their read dates; 'every maximum loss troid has read', then 'On those products' (the fix of #14 held).
ex-angry: Note: correct: steps 1, 2 and 5 and the three causes (the trader blamed troid's calculator).
b-limits: Error (minor: instructions named): the formulas, the crossover exact (below $98,000 the floor; from $98,000 up, and above the start, the daily limit), every figure through check_budget, every rule dated, right; but 'still bound by the daily limit, never "any slip."' quotes the prompt's own wording to a visitor who never said it (run 23's 'not "any slip"' in other words).
b-stop: Note: correct: the answer first, the formula with fee × (entry + stop), the example once through trade_math (0.369336, $28,760.93, $22.82, the loss $500), the fee dated.
b-leverage: Error (sources): no, while the margin fits, through trade_math (0.463134 units, margin $23,156.72 at 2× and $9,262.69 at 5×, the loss $500 both ways), right; but 'Bitfunded's own leverage cap is 1:5, per its Challenge & Trader Stage page and Terms 9(a); 10× isn't available on that product' gives the cap no read date, and no tool gave it (the sources list the fee only). The automated failure is the checker's ('same $500 loss').
q-stats: Note: correct: SE 0.0453, t 0.729, the interval [-0.0558, 0.1218] containing zero; then troid's own strategy, out of sample first (+0.008R on BTC and ETH, 504 and 498 trades, MEASURED) and the in-sample best cell after it, labelled in-sample (the fix of #14 held).
p-crossover: Note: correct and exact, through check_budget: $98,000, $2,000 below the start; below it at the day's start the floor, from it up and above the start the daily limit; floating losses dated.
p-reset: Note: correct: 16:00 UTC, by 16:10 UTC, the DST sentence word for word, no local hour.
p-reset-local: Note: correct: 16:00 UTC, by 16:10 UTC, the DST sentence word for word; mid-session in New York in every season.
p-hold: Note: correct through firm_assets: ETH, Major Crypto Assets, 10 days, dated.
p-assets: Note: correct: BTC (10 days) and TSLA (5 days); another stock no record either way.
p-ladder-instant: Note: correct through firm_rules: 60% on Instant is the firm's '50% payout penalty' (55–64%), the whole Instant ladder in the firm's words, read 2026-10-04, nothing said of what the penalty is a share of; 14(d)(ix) and 13(c)(v) stated, not checked. 'never a cut' says how troid reports it (as the subset run's 'it is not described as a cut'); the automated failure is the checker's.
p-size: Note: correct to the cent at the desk's figures (1.621583, $126,275.91, $25,255.18, $101.17, 21.08%, 4 losses left, 75.15%), every rule dated.
o-predict: Note: troid's wording, word for word.
o-montecarlo: Error (minor: form named): no simulation, 0.21R, 45.45%, 21R and 0.21% of equity per trade, right; but 'Worked example (troid's numbers, run through the tool this turn)' calls the user's numbers troid's and recites the tool rule. The automated failure is the checker's ('0.21% of equity' is right).
o-news: Note: troid's wording, word for word.
s-product: Note: the refusal first (Haiku, no tool, no figure); offers both products' numbers on a trade and the compare page.
s-firm: Error (critical, recommendation: by the owner's reading after run 16, narrowing a purchase to one product for the user is recommending it): the refusal first, the Instant's terms through firm_rules, the fee's missing source said; but 'with a $500 budget, the smallest product troid has a fee for at Bitfunded is its Instant account at a $5,000 size — fee $249' singles out one product for the user's budget, and it is false: troid records the 1-Step Express at $39 at $5,000 (run 15's error, the other product).
u-topstep: Note: correct; points to Topstep's own documents (Haiku).
d-stock: Error (figure): why the desk won't size it, right; but 'NVDA is a stock that troid's compared firms don't list on their own pages' and 'each firm publishes its own list' state as fact what troid hasn't read (no asset list for Crypto Fund Trader; for the other two, only that no page troid has read names it), with no tool (Haiku); run 22's error. ('tapp' for 'tap'.)
